subject: design/feature-draft-v1
statement: The plan is not part of the draft and is never stored in memory; after the lock, a plan may be generated from the locked version as today's plan document (`design-brainstorm:feature-draft-tech-design#D-12`). For a draft-born feature, plan-new's planning-entry precondition is the locked version's readiness, not the contract gate (`prd:feature-draft/FR-31`; `design:contract-gate-v2`, `#D-18`).
